caption: The drawing depicts two views of a red devil-like figure against a plain, light beige background. On the left, the figure is shown in a full side profile, dressed in a long, flowing red robe. It has red skin, black hair running down the back of the head, and black horns on top of the head. The face features a long black mustache and pointy goatee, and the nose is sharply pointed. The figure holds a gray trident with three prongs in its right hand, and its left hand has yellow, pointed fingernails. A pointed, red tail with a yellow tip is visible extending outward. On the right, a close-up frontal view of the head and upper robe is displayed, with a fierce expression, black eyebrows, mustache, beard, black horns, and a black collar around the neck. The collar appears fuzzy or textured, and beneath it is a large black patch on the chest area. The colors used are primarily shades of red, black, yellow, and a touch of gray for the trident, with detailed shading providing depth to the fabric and facial features. The drawing appears to be done with paint or colored pencils.
title: Hand Puppet - Devil
